data.summary: The Beitragsservice Musterstadt requests the broadcasting fee of €55.08 for October to December 2026, due on 15 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is a payment request for the quarterly broadcasting fee (Rundfunkbeitrag) for your flat. The monthly fee is €18.36, so three months come to €55.08. Transfer it by 15 November 2026 to the account printed in the letter, using only the contribution number as the reference. You can set up a SEPA direct debit to avoid future reminders. If you receive certain social benefits, such as BAföG, you can apply for an exemption. The letter contains no remedy instructions.
